verbatim_text: A person guilty of an offence under this Act for which no penalty is expressly provided shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $10,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 years or to both and, in the case of a continuing offence, to a further fine not exceeding $1,000 for every day or part of a day during which the offence continues after conviction.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf
